activities.title: Meeting Someone at a Conference
activities.instructions: Listen to Gianluca introducing himself to Carmen at a conference. Make notes about the following information.

questions.question: Why is Carmen at the conference?

activities.title: Introducing Yourself
activities.instructions: Complete what Gianluca says. Then listen again and check your answers.

questions.text: Thanks very much. Can I {{blank}} myself? I'm Gianluca Donatelli.

Roberto. Can you come here a minute? This is ... Sorry, what's your name {{blank}}?
Roberto. {{blank}} is Carmen. She's writing an article on Internet service providers.

activities.title: Matching Questions and Responses
activities.instructions: Match questions 1–8 in Exercise 3 to Carmen's responses a–h. Then listen and check your answers.
